svg.text: Agentic vulnerability research on a split control plane / data plane: shared cloud workers, or private workers inside your own network.
Authorization gate: scans run only against DNS-verified domains or targets under a signed engagement
one isolated container per job, agent code never runs on the control plane
· hardened containers: non-root, minimal capabilities, no host network or socket access
· scratch workspace per job, wiped on completion · LLM calls go directly to the provider
· finding chat, review reruns & autofix-proposal stages run here too
· agents get a restricted, registered toolset only: every shell command runs under CPU, memory & process caps
your own LLM keys, calls go
outbound-only control channel: job claims · heartbeats · results
every control here is enforced in code, not just policy
designed so a compromised or misled agent stays inside its sandbox
